rv.q: The production, which opened at the Ahmanson Theatre under the direction of Felix Barrett, is brilliantly pulled off.
A marvel... a carnival-style haunted house.
Director Felix Barrett and writer Levi Holloway have devised a crackerjack nightmare for an entire audience to eyewitness.
It's astonishing what can be done live on stage these days, but the effects in PARANORMAL ACTIVITY will blow your mind.
A sharp blend of humor and horror... this terrific new thriller is the theatrical brew for you.
It's the technical accomplishments that linger in the memory, with a cryptful of artist-magicians in keen collaboration.
The production value far outshines the script, but horror fans wanting to see dazzling and creepy effects will enjoy getting their fill.
Those seeking something deeper in their theatrical outings may want to wait this out.
With a lousy book and labored direction, Paranormal Activity tries to muster suspense, but the buildup to the scary payoffs takes forever and never really hits the mark.
Fisher's illusions are a must see and second to none: elegant, subtle, and exacting.
At times it virtually threatens to freeze the marrow in your bones, with an exhilarating freshness of invention.
This is a compact, impressively told and wonderfully acted ghost story.
The team behind Paranormal Activity has achieved something impressive — expanding the scope of what theatre can offer.
It scared the bejeebies out of me... and that didn't end at the curtain!
A slow-burn ghost story elevated by design, atmosphere, and committed performances.
In 'Paranormal Activity,' I experienced cold chills six times during the two-act play. Very satisfying.
Holloway writes with unstagey naturalism... the pair have enough charm and genuine love for each other to give the story real stakes.
It may be spun-off from a film series, but its power is embracing the theatrical.
After several repetitions, the formula becomes somewhat predictable, lessening the impact of what should be the biggest shocks.
Guaranteed to deliver the horror movie-style scares you're looking for, but if you're looking for thematic depth, you're searching the wrong haunted house.
Paranormal Activity is relentless in building intoxicating anticipation from the first blaring sound cue.
